So I have to move on to the next game.
I will keep fixing bugs for Prescience in the future.
Again, thank you for all your support! Wish you happy everyday <3

notes.title: Test Patch 0.62
notes.notes:
Hi, Hang is back! There are plenty new things that are ready for testing.


1. 2 new classes: Zhaoxi & Sitian. Each new class has about 20 neew skills.
2. buff icon display on skill cards and descriptions.
3. 8 slots for character customization. 


Follow the steps to play the test version:
 - Right click and select "Properties"
 - Select "Betas"
 - Change "Bata Participation" to "test - Playtest" (change to "None" if you want to get back to the official version)


Warnings: 
1. The test is only for Windows at the moment. It's not easy for me to make a macOS build. If you only have macOS and really want to join this test, post a comment and I'll make a macOS build as soon as possible.
2. There might be a lot of bugs. Skills might be changed in the official release. And the english localization needs to be updated. Let me know if there are bugs or balancing issues.


You can leave a comment in steam discussions if you have any suggestions.
Here's the link:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2065870/discussions/



Thank you for all your amazing suggestions and your support<3

notes.title: Development Update: New Feature - Converter
notes.notes:
I've been working on a new feature for the last 2 weeks. Here are the details:

New Feature: Converter
You can put 4 books in Converter and convert them into chess!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42583867/025c3d4065e82d290de08d13f8ba7787838efe93.gif

1. You have to put in 4 books, and the books will dissapear after the process.
2. The value of each book will be dsiplayed under the book. 
3. Here's the formula
    black > white -> Yin(black) chess; 
    white > black -> Yang(white) chess; 
    black = white and total value > 8 -> Origin chess. 


I'm going to fix bugs and tunning values for the next week.


Thank you all for your support <3

notes.title: Development Update: New Treasure Chest Battle
notes.notes:
Hi! I've been working on the treasure chest battle for the last 2 weeks. Here are the details:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42583867/b038a6f34e86b18d8892378422dd71b39caff173.png

1. The passives you might get will be displayed on the ability cards.
2. You will always use 3 yins(black chess) and 3 yangs(white chess) for the treasure chest battle. 
3. Passives with 3 different ranks will be generated for each chest. Each rank have different unlock possibility. 

    Rank 1: 25%-60%
    Rank 2: 15%-20%
    Rank 3: 10%

4: The pattern for a specific passive will always be the same. 


I'm going to work on the convert system for the convert system (A new system where you can convert 4 scrolls into a chess piece) next week.


Thank you all for your support <3

notes.title: Development Update: Apply Points and Build Character
notes.notes:
Hey buddy! Sorry for the late update information.I was taking a loooooooooong break after releasing the demo. I'm still woring on the game. 

For the last month, I was working on some new systems and making more scrolls for each class.

1. You will be able to change initial chess and scrolls for each character. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42583867/2e0ecc3a26489d7e53a77855c42522aabc35174e.png

2. And you can remove books from a class in each run to condense your random pool. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42583867/5b36923a70eb84a73dd5e655440ad2e200ec4ca3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42583867/598d8ad198de7b7057b815b28185171b29fbfeb8.png

3. While entering the next floor, you can apply points to your character to get more max health, max energy, draw limit or scroll carry limit. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42583867/5e5c0518d0d0dc9c4a7727ed7ba43a35dd271564.png

4. The game will be saved automatically, so you won't lost your game process by mistake.
